title: Income Taxes (ASC 740) — Current vs Deferred, DTA/DTL, and the Provision Entry
scenario: For the year, Meridian Building Group reports $1,000,000 of pretax book income. It includes $20,000 of municipal bond interest that is tax-exempt (a permanent difference). Tax depreciation exceeds book depreciation by $60,000 this year (a temporary difference that will reverse). The company accrued $30,000 of warranty expense for books that is deductible only when paid in a future year (a temporary difference). The enacted tax rate is 21% for all years, and no valuation allowance is needed. Use the chart of accounts in Exhibit B and round to the nearest dollar.

tasks.explanation: Taxable income = book income $1,000,000 − tax-exempt muni interest $20,000 (permanent) − excess tax depreciation $60,000 (future taxable temp difference) + warranty accrual $30,000 (not yet deductible temp difference) = $950,000.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 2 — Compute the current income tax (income tax payable).
tasks.explanation: Current tax = 21% × taxable income $950,000 = $199,500. This is the amount currently payable to the taxing authority.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 3 — Compute the deferred tax liability arising from depreciation, the deferred tax asset arising from the warranty accrual, and the net deferred tax expense.
tasks.explanation: DTL = 21% × $60,000 future-taxable difference = $12,600. DTA = 21% × $30,000 future-deductible difference = $6,300. Net deferred tax expense = $12,600 − $6,300 = $6,300.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 4 — Compute total income tax expense and the effective tax rate (as a percentage).
tasks.explanation: Total tax expense = current $199,500 + net deferred $6,300 = $205,800. Effective rate = $205,800 ÷ $1,000,000 book income = 20.58%, below the 21% statutory rate because the permanent muni-interest exclusion (21% × $20,000 = $4,200) lowers the provision.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 5 — Record the annual tax provision entry (account numbers from Exhibit B).
tasks.explanation: Dr Income tax expense $205,800; Dr Deferred tax asset $6,300; Cr Deferred tax liability $12,600; Cr Income tax payable $199,500. Debits $212,100 = credits $212,100.
